analyst.summary: Amara Raja Energy & Mobility's core lead-acid battery business is growing modestly, while its lithium-ion and EV-battery investments are real but will not contribute meaningfully to revenue for at least another year or two given the Giga-1 line's 2027 start date. At a reasonable valuation, this looks like a stable, conservatively financed company in the early-to-mid stages of a long transition, and we remain neutral pending clearer evidence of the new-energy business scaling.
